abilities.name: Assimilation
abilities.text:
Gain 10% of damage dealt from Abilities and 20% from Basic Attacks as Shields for 6 seconds. Shield amount gained doubled against Heroes.

Current maximum: 1004

abilities.name: Ravage
abilities.text:
Leap to a target, dealing 115 damage. If the enemy dies within 0.75 seconds, restore 1 charge and refund 20 Mana.

Quest: Kill enemies within a short distance of Kerrigan. Minions grant 1 stack and Heroes grant 7 stacks.

Reward: After reaching 100 stacks, Ravage deals 125 additional damage and Hero kills now provide 14 stacks.

Mythic Reward: After reaching a 250 stacks, Ravage deals a further 200 additional damage.

abilities.name: Impaling Blades
abilities.text: After 1.25 seconds, deal 150 damage to enemies within the target area, Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Primal Grasp
abilities.text: Pulls enemies within the target area towards Kerrigan, dealing 40 damage. After 2.5 seconds, an explosion occurs around Kerrigan, dealing 160 damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Summon Ultralisk
abilities.text:
After 0.5 seconds, summon an Ultralisk that rushes forward upon spawning, dealing 225 damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

The Ultralisk's Basic Attacks deal 50% of their damage in an area around their target. Reactivate to retarget the Ultralisk.

abilities.name: Maelstrom
abilities.text: Deals 74 damage per second to nearby enemies. Lasts for 7 seconds.

1.name: Siphoning Impact
1.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with Ravage grants 100 points of Assimilation Shields.

1.name: Assimilation Mastery
1.text: Regeneration Globe healing grants 50 points of Assimilation Shields per second while active. While Assimilation is active, Kerrigan's Health and Mana regeneration is increased by 150%.

1.name: Fury of the Swarm
1.text: After casting Ravage, Kerrigan's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds splashes for 100% damage around the target.

4.name: Ravaging Ferocity
4.text: Ravage grants Kerrigan 25% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

4.name: Kinetic Fulmination
4.text: Damaging an enemy increases the damage of Kerrigan's next Impaling Blades within 10 seconds by 10%, up to 100%.

4.name: Psionic Pulse
4.text: Primal Grasp explodes a second time 2 seconds after its first explosion.

7.name: Queen of Blades
7.text: Reduce the cooldown of Ravage by 4 seconds and increase its damage to Minions and Mercenaries by 100%.

7.name: Boundless Fury
7.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with Ravage grants a charge of Ravage. Can only occur once every 12 seconds per Hero.

7.name: Bladed Momentum
7.text: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Kerrigan's Basic Abilities by 0.75 seconds.

10.name: Maelstrom
10.text: Deals 74 damage per second to nearby enemies. Lasts for 7 seconds.

10.name: Summon Ultralisk
10.text:
After 0.5 seconds, summon an Ultralisk that rushes forward upon spawning, dealing 225 damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

The Ultralisk's Basic Attacks deal 50% of their damage in an area around their target. Reactivate to retarget the Ultralisk.

13.name: Psionic Barrier
13.text: Each enemy Hero hit by Primal Grasp grants 20 Spell Armor and 4% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20% Movement Speed.

13.name: Volatile Power
13.text: Increase the amount of Assimilation Shields granted from damage dealt by 10%, but reduce duration of Assimilation by 3 seconds.

13.name: Chrysalis
13.text:
Activate to place Kerrigan in a Chrysalis with 650 Health for 5 seconds. While inside, Kerrigan regenerates 4% of her maximum Health per second.

Enemies can destroy the Chrysalis to end its effects early.

16.name: Mounting Potency
16.text: Ravage grants 5% Spell Power for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

16.name: Painful Spikes
16.text: Enemies hit by Impaling Blades take an additional 60 damage the next 6 times Kerrigan damages them within 5 seconds.

16.name: Unbridled Energy
16.text: Damaging a Hero with a Heroic Ability grants 35% Spell Power for 4 seconds.

20.name: Omegastorm
20.text: Maelstrom's duration is increased by 0.4 seconds every time it damages a Hero.

20.name: Torrasque
20.text: Increase the Health and Basic Attack damage of the Ultralisk by 20%. The Ultralisk morphs into an egg when it dies. If the egg isn't killed within 4 seconds, a new Ultralisk is born.

20.name: Assimilation Blades
20.text: Damaging an enemy increases Basic Attack damage by 2% for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

20.name: Psionic Shift
20.text: Activate to teleport to a nearby location, dealing 50 damage to nearby enemies. Generates 300% increased Assimilation Shields from the damage dealt.
